response.sql:
WITH district_client_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN client AS c
      ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
)
SELECT
    region,
    AVG(client_count) AS average_clients_per_district,
    AVG(1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region)) AS average_district_share
FROM district_client_counts
GROUP BY region;

assumptions.assumption: Each district is assigned to the region recorded in district.A3; districts without clients are excluded as requested.
